verdict.rationale: Flagright's API reference names dedicated sandbox servers as the default base URLs: `https://sandbox.api.flagright.com` (eu-1) and `sandbox-asia-1` (asia-1). They are used across FRAML and Management endpoints, including batch user creation, cases and alerts. This gives developers and AI clients a separate environment to test against. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that sandbox data is isolated from production, documentation on obtaining sandbox credentials or switching to production, and independent or hands-on confirmation of sandbox behavior.
